claims.text: Mixed findings exist in the literature regarding the role social media plays in fostering social connectedness in young people.
Online tools elevate the ease with which individuals form and create online groups and communities.
Online tools can create a source of alienation and ostracism for adolescents.
Online tools create a paradox for adolescent social connectedness.

evidence.description: Mixed findings are reported regarding the role that social media plays in fostering social connectedness, which suggests that young people may experience both positive and negative psychological outcomes.
On one hand, they elevate the ease in which individuals may form and create online groups and communities...
...but on the other, they can create a source of alienation and ostracism.
As a result, this article argues that online tools create a paradox for social connectedness.

methodologies.name: Critical Literature Review
methodologies.description: A critical review of literature examining how social media use affects social connectedness across sense of belonging, psychosocial wellbeing, and identity development.
